card.name: Linking words in philosophy and art citations
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "the", "is" and "because" inside titles or quotations of philosophers like Heidegger, Adorno and Reichenbach, in essays on art and philosophy.

modes.label: Title linking word
modes.description: The word "of" or "the" inside a philosophy or art book title in a reading list.
modes.example: Heidegger – The Origin<< of>> the Work of Art Collingwood

modes.label: Inside philosopher quotes
modes.description: Small words within a quoted philosopher's sentence about play or culture.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words inside titles and quotes from philosophers in writing about art.
